metadata.title: Richmond, Virginia, HOLC residential security map (April 3, 1937), graded areas, redrawn
metadata.source_map: Home Owners' Loan Corporation, Residential Security Map, Richmond, Va., Apr. 3, 1937. National Archives, RG 195, City Survey Files (public domain), scan via FRASER, Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis: https://fraser.stlouisfed.org/files/docs/historical/maps/redline_nara/rg195_holc_Richmond_VA.pdf
metadata.georeferencing: affine fit to 33 street corners read off the scan by machine against OpenStreetMap; RMS 11.9 m, largest 23.6 m, leave-one-out RMS 13.4 m
metadata.method: Traced in code by color segmentation of the scan (tools/holc in the isoscape repo); labels as printed on the map. Done with Claude for Chris Busse, November 2026.
metadata.street_data: Control points from OpenStreetMap, (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0
metadata.not_derived_from: Mapping Inequality's polygons or control points were not used as input.
metadata.license_note: The map is a U.S. federal record in the public domain. Control-point coordinates come from OpenStreetMap (ODbL); credit '(c) OpenStreetMap contributors'.
